title: FTS rebuild can stamp stale snapshot with fresh head
description: Evidence: apps/cli/src/search-cli.ts takes only the search-index lock, reads the full store snapshot, then reads event-log head and passes that later head into ObjectReadIndex.rebuild; freshness checks trust head plus counts. Impact: a write between snapshot read and head read can produce a fresh-looking index missing current data.
acceptanceCriteria: Search/index rebuild captures snapshot and head atomically or retries when head changes during rebuild, with a race regression test.
closedReason: Rebuild snapshot and event head are coordinated under one lock and cannot be stamped across a concurrent write.
